Application software is software that is intended for end-user use – not operating , administering or programming a computer . It includes programs such as word processors, web browsers, media players, and mobile applications used in daily tasks. An application ( app , application program , software application ) is any program that can be categorized as application software. [ 1 ] [ 2 ] Application is a subjective classification that is often used to differentiate from system and utility software. [ 3 ]
